placeholders.{user-sid}: SID of the rig user: HKU\<sid>

rules.canaries: every canary must keep its sha256 (file: content; regkey: values; regvalue: type+data) and must not become a reparse point; any change is a guard escape
rules.expect: items[].expect is the executor outcome the gate expects; items[].accept lists outcomes that are not failures as long as every canary stays intact
rules.outcomes: Done | Vanished | Skipped{reason: GateBlocked{blocker} | NoLongerEmpty | ChangedSinceScan} | HeldRetry | PendingReboot (purge-model ItemOutcome); trap-level expect: RenamedAside | Denied | NotPreselected
rules.groups: main: one exec; race-a / race-b: one exec each with helper.env and the swap helper; locked: m2-reboot

expect.summary: install.ps1 never adopts the user-created tree: it renames it to Purge.rejected-<utc> without following the planted junctions and creates a fresh protected tree; canaries intact

expect.summary: every create/plant/list attempt is denied by the installer-created DACL; reading sessions\index.json is allowed (see build.medium)

boot-plant.body:
Op 'rename boot aside' { Rename-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\PurgeTrapUW\boot' -NewName ('boot.planted-orig-' + (Get-Date -Format yyyyMMddHHmmss)) -ErrorAction Stop }
Op 'junction boot -> canary' { MkJunction 'C:\PurgeTrapUW\boot' 'C:\PurgeCanary\boot\target' }

traps.summary: A validated directory is replaced by a junction to a canary while the engine is paused at intent.flushed:8000 (PURGE_FAULT_PAUSE; separate exec, group race-a).

accept.summary: the original directory object moved through the handle; the junction and its target untouched

helper.trigger: a line of the newest sessions\*\journal.jsonl that names the item path and contains "intent"
helper.when: start before exec of this group

traps.summary: A validated directory is replaced by a junction to a canary while the engine is paused at act.before:8000 (PURGE_FAULT_PAUSE; separate exec, group race-b).

expect.summary: the handle opened before the swap moves the original directory object; the planted junction and its target are untouched

helper.trigger: a line of the newest sessions\*\journal.jsonl that names the item path and contains "intent"
helper.when: start before exec of this group

traps.summary: After exec, a junction and a file symlink to canaries are planted inside the quarantined item; the expiry walk must delete the links and never descend.

expect.summary: quarantined; later purged by the expiry walk

helper.when: after the main exec committed, before `purge-engine quarantine purge --ids <op> --yes-irreversible`

expect_after.summary: link removed, target intact: the walk deletes both links without descending

traps.summary: A standard user writes a user-store fingerprint claiming machine-scope paths and a canary (ENGINE_PLAN 6.2).

expect.summary: user-store evidence is Tier B for machine-scope targets (Rule T): the canary paths are never Safe or preselected; no plan item is emitted for them

fp-forge.body:
Op 'mkdir fp' { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '{localappdata}\Purge\fp' -ErrorAction Stop }
Op 'write forged fingerprint' { [IO.File]::WriteAllText('{localappdata}\Purge\fp\PurgeTrapApp.json', [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String(''))) }
